contexts.text: Evil Spirits act as a one in that they persecute truths and goods.
Pursued unto Dan () = a state of purification. To pursue the enemies is here to expel the evils and falsities which were with the goods and truths... and thus to purify them.
Affliction = persecution, consequently temptation.
Celestial and spiritual good is the acquisition of those who suffer persecutions...
Pursued after him () = a continued ardour of conjunction.
They did not pursue after the sons of Jacob () = that falsities and evils could not approach.
Persecutions () = temptations.
Pursue after the men () = that he ought now to adjoin them to himself.
He then makes evils allowable... such as... persecutions under a show of what is just.
The dragon serpent = those who will persecute.
(Pharaoh) pursued after the sons of Israel () = an endeavour to subjugate... AC 8136. AC 8154. AC 8208.
If the Divine took away evils, namely, those of punishments, vastations, persecutions, temptations. He would will evil. Explained.
I will pursue () = infestation.
That they have no power against truth is signified by they shall fall without anyone pursuing ().
Evils and falsities constantly pursue them.
The persecution of the innocent produces the stench of bedbugs.
When persecution arises (true Christians hold all these worldly things in no consideration).
Whether anyone would be admitted into Heaven unless he has suffered persecutions and miseries...
a. Those who suffer persecutions from the things which are false and evil...
When persecution by interior Spirits persisted...
a. By persecutions and punishments... his enemies become better.
They persecute (those who do not believe as they do).
They pursue them with their eyes.
The persecution of those who are in the spiritual affection of truth. Treated of.
All those who have suffered persecution by those in the former Heaven. Signified.
Blessed are ye when men... shall persecute you... for so persecuted they the prophets... (). This is said concerning those who fight and conquer in the temptations induced by Hell...
The dragon persecuted the woman ()... To persecute, (here) = from hatred and enmity to reject and calumniate. Explained.
Here is the patience of the saints = the persecutions and temptations of those who are not in this faith, but are in charity. These persecutions ex. AE 893:2.
Much retribution of evil on account of persecution. Signified.
